findingDetails.title: Hub canonical surface description still omits the three visual references
findingDetails.claim: The sk-code surface table, surface list and layout comment describe the frontend surface without the three visual references or tokens.css, and description.json keeps the old 'web and Figma-to-code' wording and a 2026-10-10 lastUpdated.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked the surface README, surface SKILL and agent capability table, which all name the new files; the omission is confined to the hub's canonical description family.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The hub table may deliberately stay coarse; but it already enumerates the surface's domains, so leaving out the new ones makes the enumeration wrong rather than coarse.
findingDetails.scopeProof: grep for web-visual-values in sk-code/SKILL.md prints no line; the surface README and surface SKILL both name the file.

findingDetails.title: Shadow-animation performance rule did not move with the depth guidance
findingDetails.claim: The retired depth-and-detail rule that avoids transitioning box-shadow by animating a pseudo-element's opacity is absent from both new shadow and motion references.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Mapped every heading in the nine retired references to a new V/H/M item; this is the only retired section with no successor. Checked M27 and M29 for the same rule; they cover blur repaint and GPU promotion, not shadow transitions.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The consolidation may have decided the technique was too implementation-specific; the packet's own decision table only drops slides and print, so no recorded decision covers this loss.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade if a project token file or the existing web-performance-and-loading.md already carries the pseudo-element technique; it does not.
findingDetails.scopeProof: grep for pseudo-element in the two new files hits only the touch-target M9 rule, not shadow animation; the old section has no successor.

detail: The consolidated references keep every retired section except the shadow-animation technique. The hub's own surface description is the one canonical description that still omits the new files.

direction: Wholesale loss of the retired fundamentals references
reason: heading-to-item mapping finds complete successors for eight of the nine references
grep over live docs finds no line; changelog and dated benchmark history are records
